name: Nature
tagline: Your own wallpaper leads: the clearest glass for every chrome surface, a leaf-green accent, and a chat plane that stays readable. Light and dark.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: a theme file that turns on the Mac's clearest glass for the window, lets the wallpaper's hue lean into it, and gives light and dark their own moss, bark and leaf colors; settings for type and the sidebar; a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards; and a customize view whose hover card puts its status on chip glass. Nothing is painted over your wallpaper. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
